newspaper.headline: Monthly Meeting Needs Numbers Fast
newspaper.lead: PT Nusa Digital's branch managers want a sales summary. The data team prepares per-branch numbers without exposing customers' personal data.

tip.title: Tip: Summarise, Do Not Detail
tip.text: Meetings rarely need lists of names. Totals per group (GROUP BY) are usually enough, and safer.

sources: UU No. 27 Tahun 2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi

impact.good: The charts the data team checked yesterday were praised by the board: clear and honest.
impact.mixed: Some of yesterday's reports passed with notes; the board asks for more careful checks.
impact.bad: An exaggerated chart reached the board. Laras asks for every chart to be rechecked.

newspaper.classified: FOR SALE: Used calculator, the "÷ 5" key is worn out. Ask the Finance Team.

boss.title: Meeting Deadline
boss.intro: The meeting was moved up! Three things must be done now: a query, a data request and a chart.
